::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [August 1862]  
**Manuscript:** MS location unknown. This fragment printed in Mary J. Harris, 1903. <i>Memoir of Frances Mary Peard</i>, p. 48.
:::

Many thanks for this paper on Elisha,[^1] it is so exactly the thing that it makes me feel what an excellent collaborateur [you](people/person_1160.qmd) are! I believe your next is the Babylonish destruction with an eve to the final one and of course the Anti-type, but you always take the very course I like best in your comments.

---

[^1]: The article ‘Elisha’s Miracles’ with the initials F.M.P. appeared in N0. 22 of the *[Monthly Paper on Sunday Teaching](organizations/other_81.qmd)* headed ‘Tenth Sunday after Trinity. Her ‘Naaman and the leprosy’ appeared in  No 23 and her ”Destruction of Jerusalem” in No. 24.
